comparisons.peer_summary: As of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023, one customer accounted for approximately 24% and another for 16% of total consolidated accounts receivable, though the Company does not believe these balances represent significant credit risk due to past collection experience.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose significant customer concentration in their accounts receivable for fiscal year 2024, with two major customers comprising a substantial portion of the total balance in each case. NVDA reports that two customers accounted for 24% and 11% of accounts receivable as of January 28, 2024, whereas AMD reports one customer accounted for approximately 24% and another for 16% as of December 28, 2024. While the highest concentration is similar (24%), AMD's second-largest customer is slightly more significant (16% vs 11%), and AMD explicitly states that it does not believe these balances represent significant credit risk based on past collection experience, whereas NVDA's disclosure focuses purely on the statistical concentration without an accompanying credit risk assessment statement.
